entries.title: Open the authenticated dashboard
entries.caption: Opening the bare address shows this welcome dialog. Run the displayed open command to sign in locally.

entries.title: Review health findings
entries.caption: Verified structural findings and contextual review items remain distinct. Coverage gaps are explicit.

entries.title: Explain instruction discovery
entries.caption: Expected applicability is separate from client loading. Record the version and evidence from a fresh session.

entries.title: Choose scope and correction policy
entries.caption: Select profiles, roots, notification behavior and permitted managed updates. AI prose always needs review.

entries.title: Inspect eligible targets
entries.caption: Preview installation corrections before adoption. Pins and local edits stay protected.

entries.title: Review a correction diff
entries.caption: Check the exact files and correction type. The fixture applies nothing.

entries.title: Review history and recovery
entries.caption: Evidence backups preserve history. Restoring them does not re-enable permissions, schedules or corrections.

entries.title: Prepare a client review
entries.caption: Use the bounded snapshot with Codex or Cursor and import structured results. Unverified unattended execution uses the interactive handoff.

entries.title: Grant worker access locally
entries.caption: Inference pairing grants no instruction-file access. Choose roots and permissions on the worker.

entries.title: Add a custom client profile
entries.caption: Choose the owning client configuration directory and a unique profile ID. Unavailable sources remain coverage gaps.

entries.title: Choose one target correction policy
entries.caption: Automatic corrections require both selected types and approval of the exact library. Project pins and pauses remain authoritative.

entries.title: Grant bounded MCP access
entries.caption: Choose a project and client profile. The bridge can inspect, scan and propose; apply and permission changes stay outside its tools.

entries.title: Record separate delivery evidence
entries.caption: Implementation, review, integration, deployment and acceptance have independent evidence. Unknown and not applicable are valid states.

entries.title: Compare GitHub controls
entries.caption: Read observable controls using an existing login. Compare optional project governance without changing protections or merging candidates.

entries.title: Inspect health on a smaller screen
entries.caption: The instruction inventory uses the same controls on a smaller viewport. This is browser layout coverage, not a native mobile app.

entries.title: Gaming mode
entries.caption: After draining active responses, subsequent requests use the tested fallback and managed GPU residency is checked. This state is simulated; no GPU benchmark is claimed.

entries.title: Wait for the current response
entries.caption: A transition waits for the response already using the GPU. The next request can then use the fallback.

entries.title: Find models for your hardware
entries.caption: Choose Find models for my hardware. Estimated fit is shown separately from measured results.

entries.title: Review GGUF files
entries.caption: Search Hugging Face, open the file list, then review the model card, license and download size. This repository and model are fictional.

entries.title: Test a route
entries.caption: Use in project opens the route configuration. Choose primary or fallback and request CPU placement when appropriate.

entries.title: No models installed
entries.caption: An empty inventory is a starting point, not an error. Install a runtime and choose a model before configuring routes.

entries.title: Prepare driver maintenance
entries.caption: Review the target computer and update method. Confirm other clients are idle before opening that machine’s native updater.

entries.title: Pair a worker
entries.caption: Give the worker a recognizable name and paste its short-lived pairing record. The documentation leaves the credential field empty.

entries.title: Open a local Codex session
entries.caption: Select the project directory and client. The launcher starts a new session; it does not migrate a running direct-provider session.

entries.title: Run Local Codex inside Cursor
entries.caption: The supported Cursor workflow is a generated workspace with Terminal → Run Task → AI Constitution: Local Codex.

entries.title: Compare bounded coding checks
entries.caption: Choose Compare results after evaluating configured routes. Values in this example are simulated fixture results.

entries.title: Customize a baseline
entries.caption: Choose Explore baseline to edit its components and decisions. The selected web baseline includes authentication, charts, email and SQL services.

entries.title: Review a component
entries.caption: Each component records its repository, reviewed version, guidance and compatibility requirements.

entries.title: Declare environment names
entries.caption: Scroll through component details to enter acceptance checks and environment-variable names and purposes. Credential values belong in the private configuration store.

entries.title: Versions and inheritance
entries.caption: Open Versions & inheritance to inspect saved revisions or create a child of an immutable parent.

entries.title: Capture an existing project
entries.caption: Choose From existing project. Select the repository and, optionally, a private mapping to inspect variable names only.

entries.title: Review detected architecture
entries.caption: Inspect project shows supported manifest evidence before opening the proposed baseline in the editor.

entries.title: Save a private template candidate
entries.caption: Save keeps this candidate separate from the published library. Review publication under Instructions → Saved drafts.

entries.title: Apply a pinned revision
entries.caption: Enter the repository and project slug, select the revision policy, and preview generated files. Applying this plan does not install dependencies.

entries.title: Review instruction edits
entries.caption: Edit your private draft and choose Review & save draft. Validation and generated-file rebuilding happen before saving.
steps:
# Shared working defaults

Preserve existing work. Verify behavior before publishing.

entries.title: Inspect generated routing
entries.caption: Generated routing is view-only. Change source definitions and route choices, then rebuild.

entries.title: Review activation
entries.caption: Activation lists affected installations and file paths. Confirm instruction loading in a fresh client session afterward.

entries.title: Recover a previous draft
entries.caption: Draft history retains reviewed saves. Later edits are protected when undoing a save.

entries.title: Review a library refresh
entries.caption: Bring unchanged draft files up to date while preserving customizations. Activation remains a separate reviewed step.

entries.title: Choose repository roots
entries.caption: Bring my projects searches the roots you specify. It skips dependencies, build folders and filesystem links.

entries.title: Select repositories and mappings
entries.caption: Choose repositories to enroll, associate existing private configuration, and explicitly adopt portable bundles when applicable.

entries.title: Review enrollment
entries.caption: The enrollment preview lists proposed managed-file changes. Only ready repositories are enrolled when you apply.

entries.title: Resolve a synchronization conflict
entries.caption: Local managed-file edits stop synchronization for the affected project. Review the change before retrying.

entries.title: Start with no enrolled projects
entries.caption: Use Bring my projects or apply a baseline to create your first enrollment.

entries.title: Identify a subscription
entries.caption: Record the login identifier, provider, application, plan and machine. These fields identify the account without storing its password.

entries.title: Record a usage observation
entries.caption: Usage observations carry a unit, period, source and timestamp. They are separate from automatically collected quota windows.

entries.title: Configure read-only API costs
entries.caption: Select a supported organization connector and the name of an existing admin-key environment variable. Never paste the key itself.

entries.title: Inspect integration events
entries.caption: Integration logs show observation status and event codes for the selected subscription.

entries.title: Inspect worker diagnostics
entries.caption: Use Diagnostics & operation log for allowlisted support information. The example contains no credentials or conversation contents.

entries.title: Retain the last successful report
entries.caption: A failed refresh is visible while the previous successful report remains available with its observation time.

entries.title: Get a verified worker package
entries.caption: Choose Windows x64, Apple Silicon or Linux x64. Source packages support other compatible environments.

entries.title: Worker commands · windows
entries.caption: Choose the OS and package type, then copy each command into a fresh terminal. These are screenshots of the dashboard’s instructions, not the operating-system terminal.

entries.title: Worker commands · macos
entries.caption: Choose the OS and package type, then copy each command into a fresh terminal. These are screenshots of the dashboard’s instructions, not the operating-system terminal.

entries.title: Worker commands · linux
entries.caption: Choose the OS and package type, then copy each command into a fresh terminal. These are screenshots of the dashboard’s instructions, not the operating-system terminal.

entries.title: Worker version and updates
entries.caption: Review version and capabilities, check updates, manage login startup and prepare a guarded restart. Other controllers using the worker must also be idle.

entries.title: Review location changes
entries.caption: Choose new locations and review verified copies before saving. Existing storage is preserved.

entries.title: Copy and verify weights
entries.caption: Copy existing weights into a new destination. Review the file count and size before starting.

entries.title: Read release changes
entries.caption: The header notification opens Updates. Expand Release changes before choosing a verified download. The displayed release is fictional.

entries.title: Review an update restart
entries.caption: After verification, restart only when tracked and external clients are idle. Private settings and model storage are retained.

entries.title: Active work blocks restart
entries.caption: Active responses and managed sessions block restart. Finish the work and request a fresh preview.

entries.title: Review application rollback
entries.caption: Rollback uses the retained application and the same idle-service safeguards.

entries.title: Inspect changed model fields
entries.caption: Review catalog differences and routing impact. Importing definitions does not establish account access or change a running model.

entries.title: Review catalog application
entries.caption: Apply only the reviewed definitions. A transaction snapshot is retained and stale previews are refused.

entries.title: No measured profiles yet
entries.caption: Configure and evaluate a model before using measured profiles. Estimates and observations remain separate.

entries.title: Register a project configuration folder
entries.caption: Map an existing private configuration folder to its project. Only selected folders enter backups.

entries.title: Review a configuration backup
entries.caption: Check selected projects, file count, size and the actual backend destination before creating a verified backup.

entries.title: Configure encrypted backups
entries.caption: Configure the restic repository, password-file location or environment-variable name, and retention count. The password itself is never entered here.

entries.title: Initialize the repository
entries.caption: Initialize the configured encrypted repository and retain its password separately before backing up.

entries.title: Schedule backups outside the dashboard
entries.caption: Create a task for the current OS user. Its credential source must be available to the scheduled process.

entries.title: Review retention deletion
entries.caption: Deletion is limited to the reviewed snapshot IDs in this controller’s tag group.

entries.title: Select an encrypted snapshot
entries.caption: Choose a snapshot and a new directory before requesting the restoration preview.

entries.title: Review an encrypted restore
entries.caption: Restore and verify into the new private destination. Active configuration is preserved.

entries.title: Restore a local snapshot
entries.caption: Local snapshots also restore into a new directory. Review restored files before changing the project mapping.

entries.title: Review actionable failures
entries.caption: Unacknowledged failures remain visible. Open the recovery page for a fresh preview and retry.

entries.title: Keep using the dashboard during a job
entries.caption: A model download shows durable operation progress. This demonstration simulates progress without downloading weights.

entries.title: Preview support information
entries.caption: Review the allowlisted diagnostic report before downloading it. Prompts, credentials and private raw provider errors are excluded.

entries.title: Use a smaller screen
entries.caption: The same update controls remain available on a smaller viewport. This is responsive-browser coverage, not a native mobile app.

entries.title: Project cards on a tablet-sized viewport
entries.caption: Project information and actions adapt to the available width.

entries.title: Verify the instruction toolkit
entries.caption: A rendered transcript of a real isolated CLI check. This image is not a screenshot of a terminal application.

entries.title: Preview installation
entries.caption: A rendered summary from a real dry-run against a temporary home. No live Codex or Cursor files are written.

entries.title: Inspect effective setup
entries.caption: File verification, client loading, route readiness and performance remain distinct. This evidence is synthetic.

entries.title: Review a preparation recipe
entries.caption: Edit the detected recipe, select environment names, and retain its operation ID for an inspected resume.

entries.title: Review commands before execution
entries.caption: Commands and timeouts are visible; credential values are withheld. This fixture runs nothing.

entries.title: Choose local or hosted launch
entries.caption: Usage evidence assists a new launch. Account selection does not authenticate or transfer existing tasks.

entries.title: Preview a workspace rollout
entries.caption: Review individual diffs and respect pinned repositories. Use one canary before broader application.

entries.title: Review one canary
entries.caption: The canary receives its own fresh preview. Review its result before applying remaining repositories.

entries.title: Manage agent toolkits
entries.caption: Version portable rules, skills, prompt commands and MCP definitions.

entries.title: Build a small toolkit
entries.caption: Start with a useful focused manifest. Credential inputs are environment references.

entries.title: Review native adapter changes
entries.caption: Unrelated client settings are preserved. Installed files do not prove loading.

entries.title: Import portable configuration
entries.caption: Choose the explicit format and review losses before saving.

entries.title: Connect separate controllers
entries.caption: Controller scopes are independent of inference workers. This example connects no machines.

entries.title: Enable a scoped TLS listener
entries.caption: Choose this computer’s private IPv4 and port. TLS and firewall prerequisites remain explicit.

entries.title: Review controller conflicts
entries.caption: Choose remote content deliberately; staged changes still require a separate project rollout.

entries.title: Prepare another computer
entries.caption: Export a recipe, map repositories, restore encrypted configuration separately and re-verify hardware.

entries.title: Compare bounded local evidence
entries.caption: Synthetic repetitions illustrate pass counts, median duration, spread and matched regressions.

entries.title: Review an experiment budget
entries.caption: Local inference has zero paid budget. The current bounded trial finishes when canceled.

entries.title: Configure resource automation
entries.caption: Automation starts disabled. First matching rule wins, manual choices take priority and active work is deferred.

entries.title: Find workspace metadata
entries.caption: Ctrl K or Cmd K opens keyboard search. Credential files and conversation contents are excluded.

entries.title: Manage a Claude workspace
entries.caption: All collectors and automated reviews start disabled. This example is synthetic.

entries.title: Review Claude onboarding
entries.caption: A managed import preserves shared instructions and existing owner guidance.

entries.title: Use your existing login
entries.caption: Start a fresh session on the owning machine. Account state is not copied.

entries.title: Launch a qualified local route
entries.caption: The gateway manages future requests and response leases. Native acceptance remains separate.

entries.title: Choose private collection and review
entries.caption: API keys are named environment references. Subscription quotas remain unknown unless imported.

entries.title: Review using your subscription
entries.caption: A bounded snapshot is reviewed in a fresh client session; JSON results are validated separately.

entries.title: Choose isolated execution
entries.caption: This opens the explicit API/local execution choice. The capture starts no inference.

entries.title: Choose scheduled review execution
entries.caption: Handoffs remain the default. API/local reviews need separate local approval and configuration.

entries.title: One project home
entries.caption: Read installation, loading and model evidence separately.

entries.title: Choose an application and account
entries.caption: Native sign-in is unchanged; hosted operation does not require a local model.

entries.title: Start in a fresh terminal
entries.caption: Every command names the executable and private state location; pairing and file grants remain separate.

entries.title: Publish reviewed candidates
entries.caption: Candidates do not propagate until publication. Existing follow, pause and pin policies remain authoritative.

entries.title: Edit routing preferences
entries.caption: Structured fields preserve the source document; save a candidate and review publication before affecting projects.

entries.title: Explore without host access
entries.caption: Fictional projects and simulated operations live only in memory; network connections are blocked.
